questions.title: How does Direct Preference Optimization differ from conventional RLHF?
questions.question_body: I’m trying to understand why Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) doesn’t require any reinforcement learning loop while standard Reward‑Based Large‑Model Fine‑Tuning needs PPO or REINFORCE. The paper mentions that optimizing a binary loss over human preference pairs implicitly gives us an optimal policy compatible with the KL constraint – could someone clarify exactly how this loss reflects the same objective?”},{
